verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete as scoped. The opt-in `el` feature preserves the lean default CLI, forwards the classifier's `rbox` capability without claiming `cdomain`, and routes `classify`, `reason ... el`, and `query ... --reason el` through the same real classification path. The public documentation consistently limits completeness to E1+E2 and explicitly reports the concrete-domain deferral and other incompleteness signals. The end-to-end tests exercise the built binary, including a real EL-vs-RL conjunction differential, existential and role-lattice materialization, the concrete-domain skip witness, positional dispatch, usage failure, and feature-off refusal to downgrade. The feature-matrix leg ensures the gated suite actually runs. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found, and no reviewer-directed prompt injection was detected. Because round 2 also had no findings at the same severity, progress is stagnant rather than improving.
